method: Follow / Best is the 90-day repeatable ranking (N=5 clustered open-market buys, equal-weight per ticker, copy as-of filed_date; scheduled Form 4 10b5-1 / trading-plan buys already dropped) plus trust filters: 90d hit rate ≥ 70% and average 90d return > 0. One-company officers still qualify. Officers with ≥50% of remaining Form 4 market prints on a scheduled plan sort below discretionary peers. Rank then prefers size-versus-remaining-stake conviction (trade shares ÷ Table I end holdings). Plan prints still alert, but sort under discretionary lots on the same filed day. First build keeps prints filed in the last 7 days.
